title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-q4fj: duplicate subtle key in lichen-oscore/Cargo.toml blocks workspace compilation
description: Duplicate dependency entry 'subtle' on lines 24 and 32 of rust/lichen-oscore/Cargo.toml causes 'error: duplicate key' from Cargo, blocking all workspace-level cargo commands (check, build, test, clippy). Remove the duplicate at line 32. Discovered during code review of commit 79ae4ab.
